What is No-Contact Fishing Guide Service?

Clients typically call Baxstar with a fish species or a lake in mind.  They just need guidance to help them reach their goals.  Baxstar provides each client with a customized plan to catch fish, including where to go, what time is right, and what to use.  We even send GPS locations of fishing hot spots.
